Game Overview

War of Islands Mine and Craft puts players into a casual experience centered on lead your army to victory by mining resources and exchanging them for gold to expand your military camp. Strategically construct barracks, upgrade facilities, and recruit the strongest warriors. Command and conquer as you unleash your formidable forces on rivals in epic battles. Can you reign supreme?

How to Play

Each session of War of Islands Mine and Craft follows a consistent rhythm. Lead your army to victory by mining resources and exchanging them for gold to expand your military camp. Strategically construct barracks, upgrade facilities, and recruit the strongest warriors. Command and conquer as you unleash your formidable forces on rivals in epic battles. Can you reign supreme?
